strategy.title: No executable plan: the offer's price is contradicted
strategy.why: The only opening's price is recorded as $900 on the card but $90 in the sourced price fact. At the sourced $90, the evidenced 10% conversion (26 of 260) over the 260 registered stables yields 26 deals = $2,340, short of $4,000; only the unsourced $900 reaches the target. The price is therefore not established and decides whether any plan exists.
